basic_details.job_title: MANUU Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 9 Professor, Associate Professor and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Professor - Education, Assistant Professor - Education, Professor (Botany) and 5 more
basic_details.short_information: Maulana Azad National Urdu University (MANUU), Hyderabad, Telangana, has invited applications for 9 posts in 8 roles under Advt No. 74/2026. The posts include Professor - Education, Assistant Professor - Education, Professor (Botany), Professor (B.Voc. (MIT)) and 4 more. The online application is open from 17 November 2026 to 1 December 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: Postgraduate / Master's degree with 55% marks, Ph.D., publications and research score as per UGC norms (NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D. for Assistant Professor); M.D./M.Sc. options for B.Voc. posts; Bachelor's and Master's for HoD; knowledge of Urdu compulsory

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Postgraduate degree with minimum 55% marks in the discipline relevant to the area of specialization; Postgraduate degree in Education (M.Ed/M.A. Education) with minimum 55% marks; Eminent scholar with Ph.D. in Education or relevant discipline, minimum 10 research publications and research score of 120; Knowledge of Urdu. Experience required: Minimum ten years of teaching experience as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor and/or equivalent research experience, with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate. Age limit: Maximum 65 years. Pay: ₹ 1,44,200-2,18,200 (Academic Level 14). how_to_apply: Fill the online application form on https://curec.samarth.ac.in by 01.12.2026.
Pay the Registration Fee of Rs. 500 through online mode only (SC/ST/PwD & Women exempted).
Take the printout of the submitted online application.
Attach all self-attested certificates and supporting documents, indexed and paginated in order of essential eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MANUU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 1 December 2026. Applications opened on 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MANUU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 9 vacancies: 2 Professor - Education, 1 Assistant Professor - Education, 1 Professor (Botany), 1 Professor (B.Voc. (MIT)), 1 Associate Professor (B.Voc. (MLT)), 1 Associate Professor (Linguistics, Dept. of English) and 2 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MANUU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 1 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All other candidates: Rs. 500 (Registration Fee). SC/ST/PwD & Women: Exempted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 65 years (as on 30 November 2026).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: ₹ 1,44,200-2,18,200 (Academic Level 14) for Professor - Education, ₹ 57,700-1,82,400 (Academic Level-10) for Assistant Professor - Education, ₹ 1,44,200-2,18,200 (Academic Level 14) for Professor (Botany), ₹ 1,44,200-2,18,200 (Academic Level 14) for Professor (B.Voc. (MIT)), ₹ 1,31,400-2,17,100 (Academic Level 13A) for Associate Professor (B.Voc. (MLT)).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Postgraduate / Master's degree with 55% marks, Ph.D., publications and research score as per UGC norms (NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D. for Assistant Professor); M.D./M.Sc. options for B.Voc. posts; Bachelor's and Master's for HoD; knowledge of Urdu compulsory. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Knowledge of Urdu is compulsory for all teaching posts. SLET/SET valid only for appointment in the respective state. In-service Government candidates must apply through proper channel or submit a No Objection Certificate.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Associate Professor (Linguistics): only candidates with Master degree in Linguistics / English can apply. Candidates with foreign Ph.D. without AIU Equivalence Certificate. In-service candidates who do not submit NOC by the interview will not be allowed to appear.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening and short-listing of applications. Test / Interview. Screening Committees may scrutinize applications and short-list candidates, possibly on qualifications and experience higher than the minimum. Assistant Professor: academic score (Appendix II, Table 3A) used for short-listing only; selection based only on interview performance.
